## E — Market signal: emergencies and crashes
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (NC-EMG-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Handbook-only observation, not market evidence: skid steering and blowout responses run against instinct, so scenario drills may add value beyond plain recall.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.
